plan.failureSummary: Cached Page.AI replay failed to locate 'Last Name' input field on an unstable survey form variant (Set 2).
observedIndicators: Failure occurred during DETERMINISTIC cache replay in .cache-lock/unstable-survey.test.ts.cache.js
Cached replay attempted to find '[data-testid=\'input-lastname\']' / 'Last Name *' input
Failure screenshot displays a different form structure ('Set 2') with 'Your Name *' and 'Contact Email *' instead of separate first/last name fields
The page.ai instruction ('Fill out the all of the survey questions with fake data...') has high semantic flexibility and can adapt autonomously upon cache clearance

remediationSteps.summary: Clear Page.AI cache and retry test
remediationSteps.details: Clear the cached instructions for unstable-survey.test.ts and allow Page.AI to execute autonomously against the current form layout.

plan.notes: The test runs against an unstable survey application that alternates form field schemas/sets. Clearing the Page.AI cache will let the agent autonomously adapt to the active form variant.
